desc.en:
Stunning Renovated Townhouse with Rooftop Pool and Panoramic Sea Views in Cómpeta
Located in the picturesque white village of Cómpeta, this beautifully renovated townhouse combines elegant interiors, generous living spaces, and breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea and surrounding mountains.
Finished to a high standard throughout, the property offers a bright and spacious layout. The entrance hall leads into a a double bedroom featuring an en-suite bathroom and access to a patio with a utility/laundry room.
A striking staircase connects the levels. On the first floor, you’ll find a fully equipped open-plan kitchen with dining and large living room with a pellet stove, plus a second double bedroom with en-suite bathroom. The top floor hosts an office/library, alongside a third bedroom with its own en-suite.
The home retains its Andalusian character with high ceilings, terracotta tiles, mosaic flooring, and wooden doors and windows with shutters. Comfort is ensured with air conditioning, heating, ceiling fans, built-in wardrobes, and heated towel rails in all bathrooms.
The true highlight is the series of terraces spread across multiple levels. The first offers a shaded seating area under a reed pergola, ideal for summer days. The rooftop features two levels: the lower includes storage, a shower, and toilet, while the upper terrace impresses with a built-in summer kitchen, gas barbecue, dining area, chill-out seating, and a private pool. From here, enjoy uninterrupted panoramic views over the sea, mountains, and the village church tower—especially magical at sunset.
A rare and exceptional home offering space, privacy, and authentic Andalusian living at its finest.

title.en: Townhouse for sale in Cómpeta

desc.en:
Welcome to Cortijo Manolo,
Situated in a beautiful, central location on the Costa Tropical, in the charming village of Vélez de Benaudalla, you’ll find this unique property that perfectly combines tranquillity with easy access to amenities. Here, you’ll live surrounded by nature, amidst peace and greenery, whilst still having all amenities within easy reach. In just 15 minutes you can reach the lively centre of Motril and its beautiful beaches, and in 10 minutes you’ll be in the picturesque village of Vélez de Benaudalla. Granada city and the impressive Sierra Nevada mountains are also about a 45-minute drive away, whilst the enchanting Lecrín Valley with its breathtaking landscapes is just 20 minutes away.
Upon arrival at the property, you are immediately immersed in an oasis of tranquillity. A charming terrace with a swimming pool, a characterful olive tree and a beautifully appointed outdoor kitchen with barbecue form the heart of outdoor living. Here you can enjoy a panoramic view that never ceases to fascinate, with vistas over the mountains and the Sierra Nevada.
The property itself is entirely on one level, offering optimal comfort without any stairs. Inside, the pleasant natural light immediately catches the eye, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere together with the open-plan living space. The living room with its open-plan kitchen is ideal for the cooler months and flows seamlessly into the stylish open-plan kitchen. The property also features three bedrooms and a bathroom.
At the rear of the house are three unfinished rooms offering a wealth of possibilities. Whether you wish to create extra bedrooms, a guest house or even a completely separate flat, the choice is yours. One of these rooms also has direct access to the garden, making it easy to create a separate entrance. This room currently has a garage door.
The garden itself is a space full of potential and charm. Currently, there are beautiful olive trees growing there, and there is a small workshop or garden shed which, with a bit of refurbishment, could offer added value. The plot is situated on a slope, creating different levels and unique spots. At the bottom is a particularly peaceful and private area where you can enjoy nature in complete serenity.
This property offers an exceptional opportunity for those looking for a holiday home, an investment, a rental property (currently unlicensed) or a permanent, ready-to-move-in home under the Spanish sun.
The property is connected to the mains electricity and water supply and features a recently installed eco-friendly septic tank. The motorway is just 10 minutes away. The final 5 minutes to the property are via a gravel track, which is, however, easily accessible by a standard car.
Interested or would you like more information? Please contact us!

Welcome to Villa Summer Winds, an exclusive property tucked away in a quiet cul-de-sac within the popular Monte de los Almendros residential development, on the sun-drenched coast of Granada.
This characterful villa, designed by architect Kuntz, stands out for its playful layout and strong connection with the surroundings. With a living area of 335 m² on a plot of 841 m², the house is built on several levels that follow the landscape, offering ever-changing views of the sea, mountains and historic Salobreña.
The lower floor forms an almost self-contained living space, with an open-plan living area and kitchen, a comfortable bedroom and a stylish bathroom featuring a private sauna. Thanks to direct access to the swimming pool, this is the perfect spot for guests or pure relaxation.
One floor up lies the central living area of the property. Here, the kitchen and living room flow seamlessly into one another, and large windows open onto a spacious terrace with an impressive view of the Mediterranean Sea. This floor also features two bright bedrooms, one with an en-suite bathroom, both with access to the outside.
At the very top is a unique space in the villa’s tower. This is currently used as an office, but could just as easily serve as an extra bedroom or an inspiring retreat, complete with a balcony offering panoramic views.
The outdoor areas are equally delightful: a swimming pool with a sun terrace, a cosy lounge area under a pergola, and a lush garden with mature trees and various fruit varieties such as mango, fig and lemon create an oasis of tranquillity and privacy.
The property also features a secure garage and several parking spaces on site.
Villa Summer Winds is a special place where architecture, comfort and location come together, ideal for those seeking something truly unique on the Costa Tropical.
This stunning villa offers exceptional versatility, perfect as a family residence, a smart investment opportunity, a luxurious holiday retreat, or a high-yield rental property with strong year-round income potential.

Andalusian elegance at its finest!
Discover the magic of the Andalusian countryside with this stunning, fully renovated cortijo in Villanueva del Trabuco, just 35 minutes from Málaga. A beautiful property in an ideal location, within walking distance of a cosy bar/restaurant where you can enjoy local delicacies and the warm atmosphere of the Andalusian community. Just a five-minute drive takes you to the lively Villanueva del Trabuco, a charming village with around 5,000 inhabitants. Here you’ll find everything you need, from shops and supermarkets to cosy cafés and events that make the village a bustling and vibrant place.
Surrounded by vast olive groves, this authentic cortijo exudes pure charm and serenity. An authentic Andalusian property with a soul. The property has been finished to a high standard and is characterised by charming, handcrafted details such as solid wood doors, wrought-iron fittings and terracotta roof tiles. The over 100-year-old doors in the inner courtyard are made from a single piece of wood, reinforced into the wall and well worth seeing! Once a highly successful bed and breakfast, it offers an excellent opportunity to realise both a dream home and a source of income. The cortijo has been acclaimed for its exceptional service, attention to detail and the unique charm of this privileged spot.
The property has been lovingly renovated to preserve its rustic charm, whilst seamlessly integrating modern comforts. Divided into two separate sections, the cortijo comprises the original main building and an annexe, both in the same enchanting style. The two residential units each have their own entrance, offering privacy and flexibility.
The original part of the cortijo welcomes you with two cosy living rooms, a dining room, a spacious bedroom with an en-suite bathroom, an office and a fully equipped kitchen. From one of the living rooms, you step out onto an enchanting courtyard, where you can enjoy a fine glass of wine by candlelight whilst admiring the starry sky. The first floor houses four charming bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, three of which are en-suite. The rooms exude typical Andalusian charm, with wooden beams and beautiful tiled floors. Two of the rooms have their own terrace with breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape.
The 1,219 m² plot is a true paradise with lush plants, hidden nooks and several lounge areas. The swimming pool invites you to relax, whilst the covered seating area is ideal for hot summer days. The terrace features two outdoor showers with hot and cold water.
The annexe offers a cosy living room, kitchen, guest toilet and storage space on the ground floor, with two bedrooms on the upper floor, one of which has an en-suite bathroom and private terrace.
The grounds also feature a large garage and several outbuildings, offering the potential for further expansion, for example to create additional bedrooms, a studio or a gym. The cortijo has central heating, a brick-built barbecue and parking facilities. Wherever you are on the grounds, you will enjoy absolute peace, privacy and relaxation.
The combination of the cortijo’s serene tranquillity and the proximity to this charming village offers the best of both worlds: rural relaxation and lively village life within easy reach. We look forward to showing you this dream home, either in person or via a virtual tour. Don’t miss this unique opportunity to become the owner of a little piece of paradise in the heart of Andalusia!

In this place you will find all the peace and quiet yet with all the necessities such as schools, supermarkets, shops, restaurants and a health centre within easy reach. This fantastic finca is ready for a new owner, to put their own hand to all the possibilities this property with plot offer. desc.en:
In the heart of the enchanting Axarquía region, where the hills roll gently to the horizon and white villages sparkle under the Andalusian sun, lies the picturesque village of Comares. Known for its unspoilt nature, extensive hiking trails and breathtaking panoramic views, this region is often praised as one of the most beautiful areas in southern Spain. Comares itself, majestically situated on a mountain ridge, offers spectacular views over valleys, olive groves and impressive mountain ranges. The village exudes history. Centuries ago, it was inhabited by the Moors, and their influence can still be felt today in the narrow streets, the architecture and the warm, authentic atmosphere that makes the village so unique. Here, peace, beauty and a timeless feeling of coming home reign supreme.
On the edge of this beautiful white village, in a small and quiet street with phenomenal mountain views, is one of the most beautiful properties in Comares, considered by many to be the jewel of the village. What makes this house truly exceptional is its rare and completely walled garden: an oasis of privacy and greenery that is hard to find in the village.
A large, old traditional wooden gate leads to a paradise-like courtyard garden. Fruit trees, stately cypresses and an abundance of flowers create an intimate, Mediterranean atmosphere where tranquillity and beauty come together. There are two separate houses on the estate, harmoniously integrated into this unique setting. Both houses have their own kitchen, bathroom and bedrooms, offering countless possibilities — from spacious private living to guest accommodation or investment property.
The various terraces in the courtyard garden are carefully oriented so that one can enjoy sun or shade at any time of the day. One terrace, with a charming American swing, offers breathtaking views of the mountains — a place where time seems to stand still. The garden also features a beautiful old, large fireplace, ideal for gathering around the fire in the evening or organising an atmospheric barbecue under the starry sky.
The main house has been completely renovated with respect for its Moorish inspiration, a subtle reference to the rich history of the village. Authentic elements have been preserved, while all electricity and water pipes have been completely renewed, ensuring contemporary comfort.
Upon entering, one is welcomed into an impressive high-ceilinged living space with a ceiling height of no less than five metres. This space exudes grandeur and warmth and is equipped with a new Brunner wood-burning stove — of the highest quality — which, together with the cosy TV seating area, creates a luxurious and comfortable atmosphere. Adjacent to this is a second living room, furnished for atmospheric low dining with a beautiful Moroccan salon. A new quality stove has also been installed here, giving each room warmth and character.
The bathroom on the ground floor has been completely renovated and combines modern comfort with authentic charm. The kitchen has also been completely renovated and equipped with new appliances, a new built-in fireplace and high-quality equipment, including a Samsung refrigerator, new washing machine and dryer in the practical utility room. From the kitchen, there is direct access to a particularly stylish outdoor kitchen with a recently built barbecue and sink — a dream for those who love long summer evenings and outdoor dining.
Upstairs there are two bedrooms, one of which opens onto a pleasant terrace with, once again, impressive views of the mountains. The second house, located in the garden, offers a cosy living area with kitchen and a new bathroom on the ground floor. On the first floor, there is an exceptionally spacious and idyllic room with five large windows overlooking the mountain landscape. A new fireplace insert has also been installed here, providing comfort and atmosphere throughout the year.
This property is undoubtedly unique and rare. It combines authenticity, charm, privacy and comfort in a way that is rarely found. The house is sold fully furnished and is ready to move into, including furnishings and household goods. It offers the possibility to live in the larger house yourself and use the smaller one as a guest house or investment property.
In addition, the adjacent house is also being offered for sale by the same owner, our reference R5309233. Together, these properties can be combined into one impressive complex with three houses — ideal as an exclusive family property or as a particularly attractive holiday rental project.
Comares is surrounded by numerous hiking trails, including several GR paths, and is a perfect base from which to discover Andalusia. Located in the triangle between Granada, Seville and Córdoba, and only 35 minutes from the coast and 45 minutes from Málaga airport, this location combines absolute tranquillity with excellent accessibility.
For those looking for something truly exceptional — an authentic and characterful property with soul, history and breathtaking views — this house is a unique opportunity. A rare gem in the heart of Andalusia, ready to welcome a new owner who appreciates beauty, tranquillity and exclusivity.
Contact us quickly for a viewing! It can also be done virtually!

Luxury Villa with Spectacular Views and B&B License in Archez.
This modern architect-designed villa, built in 2004, offers breathtaking views of La Maroma and the whitewashed villages of Cómpeta and Canillas de Albaida. With 340 m² of living space on a 6,000 m² plot, it combines comfort, privacy and nature – just 5 minutes from Archez, 15 minutes from Cómpeta, and 30 minutes from the Mediterranean coast.
The villa features five spacious bedrooms, each with a modern en-suite bathroom, air conditioning, and ceiling fans. The bright living area with a wood-burning stove flows seamlessly into the open-plan kitchen, equipped with natural stone countertops, a breakfast bar, and full modern appliances. A conservatory with panoramic views provides the ideal place to relax. An additional room can serve as an office, library, TV room, or extra bedroom. A utility room and the service area “La Cantina” complete the interior. Double glazing, insect screens, and shutters throughout add to the overall comfort.
Outdoors, the property offers a 9x4 m pool with a gradual depth and wide steps, surrounded by sun and shaded terraces with various seating areas. A covered bamboo terrace and an outdoor shower create a pleasant setting. The adjoining pool house contains all technical equipment, keeping the area tidy and well-maintained. The grounds are fully enclosed, with a paved driveway, parking for four cars, an electric gate, storage room, firewood shelter, and motion-sensor lighting.
Sustainability at its core: The villa is equipped with ten photovoltaic solar panels, thermal solar panels for hot water, a heat pump for the pool and underfloor heating, and a 15 m³ rainwater collection system for irrigating the gardens and fruit trees. Several landscaped garden areas and fruit trees spread over three terraces are maintained via an automatic irrigation system.
The property holds a Casa Rural rental license and is currently run successfully as a B&B, but it is equally well suited as a holiday retreat or large family home. All paperwork, including the DAFO certificate, is in place. The existing B&B name, website, marketing materials, and booking system can be transferred if desired.
Experience the exceptional space and elegance of this villa, and be captivated by its spectacular views and refined design.

This stylish villa is located in the exclusive and serene residential area of Monte de los Almendros in Salobreña, a property that excels in finish, comfort and tranquillity. The villa is located on a quiet cul-de-sac, ensuring privacy and relaxation. From various terraces and from the living area, you can enjoy a beautiful panoramic view of the Mediterranean Sea, where the sun sets spectacularly on the horizon in the evening.
When you enter the property, you first arrive at an elegantly landscaped front terrace in Mediterranean style, an inviting place that immediately sets the tone for the house. Through the impressive entrance hall, you reach the main floor, a modern living space that was completely renovated in 2019 and equipped with electric blinds, air conditioning for both heating and cooling, and an attractive stove. The large windows provide a sea of light and connect the interior with the exterior. This floor also features two spacious bedrooms, a luxurious bathroom with underfloor heating, and a fully equipped kitchen with high-quality appliances and every comfort. The entire house has 40 mm external insulation, which contributes to a pleasant indoor climate and efficient energy management. In addition, the house is equipped with secure, reinforced windows.
The villa is cleverly designed with three separate floors, each of which can be locked independently. This makes the property perfect for rental, for guests, or for those who like to combine privacy with flexibility. The top floor forms an independent living level and offers a magnificent master bedroom with breathtaking sea views. Here you will also find a private luxury bathroom, a large terrace and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen with BBQ — an ideal place to spend long Mediterranean evenings.
The lower floor also offers complete privacy and is currently successfully rented out as a holiday apartment all year round. This independent accommodation has its own terrace, a well-kept garden with direct access to the swimming pool, a cosy living area, a spacious bedroom, bathroom, kitchen and electric heating. There is also a surprising amount of storage space throughout the property, allowing everything to be stored neatly and organised.
Outside, you can enjoy a beautifully landscaped garden with automatic irrigation, which takes care of both the lush green lawn and the various fruit trees — including orange, lemon, grapefruit, papaya, nísperos, olive and palm trees. The large swimming pool (8.2 m x 4.1 m) has a connection for heating and works with an automatic chlorine system, safely concealed in a maintenance room. Various terraces have been laid out around the pool, so there is always a place to be found in the sun or shade.
The property also has a double carport with solar panels. Although there is no battery, the panels contribute to an efficient energy supply. The house is connected to the community's drinking water and electricity supply and also has an ecological septic tank.
Thanks to its location close to the beaches, the historic centre and the restaurants of Salobreña, as well as easy access to the motorway, this villa is an exceptional opportunity for those looking for a carefree second home on the Andalusian coast — or for those who would like to combine living with renting. The property was built in 2004 and has a living area of approximately 382 m². It is surrounded by its own fenced grounds of 60 hectares, which include around 1,000 almond and olive trees. The finca has seven rooms, including several bedrooms, and three bathrooms plus a guest toilet.
The house is connected to the electricity grid and is heated by a cosy fireplace in the living room. Water is supplied by a private well, as well as two large water tanks with a capacity of 30,000 litres and 150,000 litres of rainwater. The grounds are also suitable for private hunting.

On the ground floor, you will find a spacious, semi-open living and dining room that has plenty of natural light and can be flexibly arranged. From the living room, large sliding doors lead to the spacious balcony, which runs the entire length of the house and offers panoramic views of the surrounding countryside.

All bathrooms in the house have natural light.
An elegant white marble staircase leads to the upper floor, where there is an attractive tower room. This room offers a magnificent view thanks to three windows overlooking the landscape. The en-suite bathroom is equipped with a double sink, a bidet and a bathtub.
The basement extends over the entire surface area of the house and has been converted into additional living space. Here you will find a large open space with three separate rooms and an additional bathroom with shower. This floor can be furnished as a guest house, studio, gym or hobby room, as desired.
Outdoor space and surroundings
The finca is fully fenced and accessible via a lockable entrance gate from the main road. The vast grounds consist of pine forests, olive groves and mountain slopes reaching up to 800 metres in height. This natural environment offers plenty of opportunities for hiking, hunting, gardening or simply relaxing in peace and privacy.

Holding a tourist licence, the property is ready for use as a holiday rental, boutique B&B, or private home with potential for separate guest accommodation. Inside, the house blends traditional features—terracotta tiles, whitewashed walls, and antique wooden doors—with modern upgrades throughout. The ground floor opens into a charming Andalusian vestibule leading to a bright reception area, cozy lounge, and small office with a wine nook. Large glass doors fill the space with natural light and connect seamlessly to the outdoor terrace. A spacious double bedroom on this level offers flexibility as an owner’s suite or guest room. The dining area, with its high ceilings and window seat, leads into a fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances and direct terrace access. A contemporary bathroom with a walk-in shower completes this floor. Outside, multiple terraces provide sun, shade, and privacy. The enclosed lounge and bar area is perfect for alfresco dining and entertaining, while the upper terrace—with panoramic views of the El Hacho Sierra, countryside, and church tower—features a hot tub and seating for sunset relaxation. Upstairs, a beautiful tiled staircase leads to three generous double bedrooms, each with unique character. The first features antique carved wardrobes, while the second and third share a stylish Jack-and-Jill bathroom. Light-filled spaces and traditional design details create an inviting atmosphere throughout. Whether as a family home, boutique guesthouse, or investment property, this townhouse offers flexibility, comfort, and a true taste of authentic Spanish living in the heart of Álora.

A Historic Investment Opportunity in Casarabonela “Where History Sleeps and Grandeur Awakes”
Casarabonela, Málaga | 535 m² | 10 Bedrooms | 3 Floors In the heart of the charming Andalusian village of Casarabonela lies a truly exceptional property waiting for its next custodian. This majestic historic mansion, steeped in elegance and heritage, radiates a sense of timeless grandeur. Behind its stately façade, history lingers — whispers of a time when José I Bonaparte, brother of Napoleon, once spent the night within its walls. . Now, more than two centuries later, this remarkable residence is ready to welcome new stories and great ambitions. With an impressive 535 square metres spread over three floors and ten bedrooms, the property offers extraordinary potential. The first phase of renovation has already been completed: the roof and upper floor have been expertly restored, preserving the home’s original character while ensuring lasting quality. The remaining spaces await a fresh vision — a blank canvas for a discerning investor or dreamer. Imagine transforming it into a boutique hotel, where every room tells its own story. Or perhaps a fine dining restaurant paired with a wellness retreat in the atmospheric cellar, creating an unforgettable haven of luxury and authenticity. This is not merely a house to live in — it is a piece of history to cherish, to reimagine, and to bring back to life. A rare opportunity to transform heritage into future, right in the heart of one of Andalusia’s most picturesque villages.

This stylish, quality built, immaculately presented, 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom, country villa is located between the Andalucian pueblos of Álora and Valle de Abdalajis in Málaga province. Set within its private olive grove of 14,000m2, planted out with 300 productive olive trees.
The total build size is 108m2 plus a glorious wrap around partially covered terrace of approx. 100m2.
The accommodation is all on one level offering an open plan living room/ dining room/ kitchen, 3 double bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and an outside laundry room/ storeroom with WC. The property hosts vaulted wooden ceilings creating an atmosphere of light and space. The fitted kitchen benefits from integrated oven and microwave and gas hob and also dish washer. The 3 bedrooms are all doubles; one has fitted wardrobes and one enjoys an ensuite shower room.
The finishes throughout the property are of a high standard including double glazed windows, energy efficient air-conditioning heating/cooling system and an energy efficient wood burning stove. This property enjoys particularly generous outdoor entertaining areas with wrap around expansive terraces ideal for " al fresco" dining.
The property enjoys a rural location, enjoying fabulous views of the Andalucian countryside, with access via a very short track from a tarmac road. All local amenities including Álora train station are less than 15 minutes’ drive from the property.
Mains electricity is connected and there are 2 private wells. The owner has established 25,000 litres water storage capacity.
This property holds the coveted SAFO license and offers the opportunity to acquire a fully regularized country villa and a productive olive grove, less than 1 hour's drive from Malaga city and international airport.

title.en: Finca - Cortijo for sale in Alora

This cozy finca features 3 bedrooms (2 with air conditioning) and 1 bathroom. The spacious living room with open kitchen also has air conditioning and a wood-burning stove. The property is in generally good condition and offers great potential. Some minor finishing touches are still needed, including the partially installed kitchen – a perfect opportunity to create your own little paradise.
Outside, you’ll find a small pool of approximately 7 m² that requires some renovation – ideal for cooling off on warm summer days while enjoying stunning mountain views.
The location is truly fantastic: surrounded by nature with breathtaking views, yet easily accessible via a concrete road. Only 10 minutes from the main road and about 20 minutes from the charming village of Álora, which has a train station with connections to Málaga and the coast.
Thanks to Álora’s growing popularity – partly due to the world-famous Caminito del Rey – this property is not only a wonderful place to live but also an excellent investment for tourist rentals.
The house is connected to electricity, water is supplied via its own deposit, and the property also features two wells. The large plot is ideal for keeping horses or other animals.
A unique opportunity to enjoy peace, nature, and authentic Spanish charm – with all amenities within easy reach.

Exceptional Cortijo for Sale in Frigiliana – A Timeless Andalusian Retreat
Discover this breathtaking Cortijo at just 500 meters from the enchanting village of Frigiliana and a mere 4 km from the sun-kissed beaches of Nerja. Spanning over 7,000 m² of lush, mature gardens, this mid-20th-century estate, steeped in historical charm, comprises three detached houses crafted in traditional Andalusian style. Perfectly blending privacy, intimacy, and independence, this property is an idyllic setting for a luxurious Bed and Breakfast, a multi-generational family haven, or a lucrative investment opportunity with an existing holiday rental license.
Property Highlights: Unmatched Location: Situated in the heart of Frigiliana, in the Malaga Province, one of Spain’s most picturesque villages, renowned for its colourful, winding streets and rich cultural heritage shaped by Arab, Jewish, and Christian influences. Only minutes from Nerja’s iconic Balcón de Europa, Nerja Caves, and Chillar River Route.
Historical Significance: Once the residence of an actress and an English naval engineer who introduced Californian Fuerte avocado trees to Frigiliana in the 1960s, this estate carries a legacy of cross-cultural charm, connecting Lincoln, England, to the Costa del Sol.
Sprawling Grounds: A 7,132 m² plot adorned with romantic gardens, a traditional Andalusian oven, trellises, gazebos, a fish pond, stone sculptures, fountains, and ancient olive trees. Connected to mains electricity and water, the property ensures seamless living, while a substantial water deposit provides eco-friendly irrigation for its breathtaking garden. The expansive grounds are a horticultural haven, boasting 23 vibrant citrus trees, 3 thriving avocado trees, 2 lush mango trees, and 100 majestic olive trees, creating a picturesque and fruitful landscape. Ideal for those seeking a tranquil retreat with sustainable charm, this villa promises a lifestyle of elegance and harmony with nature. The south-facing orientation ensures breathtaking views of the rolling mountains and verdant valleys from every angle. The traditional Andalusian oven and barbecue area make outdoor entertaining effortless, while the swimming pool invites relaxation under the Costa del Sol sun.
Interior: the main house is sold unfurnished, the guest houses are sold furnished.
Versatile Income Potential: With a holiday rental license and a proven track record of excellent reviews, this property offers significant returns for investors or seasonal use as a vacation home.
Ample Parking: Private driveway with enclosed parking and separate entrances for each house ensure convenience and accessibility.
Interior Features: the main house is sold unfurnished, the guest houses are sold furnished.
This cluster of three south-facing houses, constructed in the 1940s, exudes timeless Andalusian elegance with modern comforts. Each home boasts its own unique character:
Main Villa: Enter through historic wooden doors into a double-height hallway. The ground floor features a spacious living room with a wood-burning fireplace, opening to a terrace and lush gardens, a guest WC, a multi-purpose room, and a kitchen with indoor-outdoor areas, complete with a barbecue for summer entertaining. Upstairs, find three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a solarium offering panoramic views of the sea, mountains, and valleys.
First Guest House: A cozy retreat with a living room featuring a fireplace, a kitchen, two bedrooms, a family bathroom, and a private terrace for intimate gatherings.
Second Guest House: This home includes a large covered patio at the entrance, an open-plan living room with an integrated kitchen, a spacious bedroom with an additional terrace, and a bathroom, perfect for guests or extended family.
Additional amenities: include air conditioning, fitted wardrobes, electric heating, and small storage rooms on the grounds, ensuring practicality meets charm.
We will love to show you this unique property either virtually or live if you are in the neighbourhood!

Discover Lavanda Villas: Your new home in El Limonar, Vélez-Málaga
Welcome to Lavanda Villas, an exclusive new-build development of 30 semi-detached villas, located in the charming neighbourhood of El Limonar in Vélez-Málaga. Designed with comfort, safety and family well-being in mind, this gated residential complex offers a peaceful environment where modern living and the natural beauty of the Costa del Sol come together.
A place for your family Lavanda Villas consists of 30 spacious villas, spread over three floors with a smart and functional layout. With a living area of 177 m² and plots of up to 260 m², you will enjoy space, light and comfort for an exceptional lifestyle.
Spaces that adapt to your life The ground floor welcomes you with an open, bright living space of over 35 m². Here you will find a modern open-plan kitchen with plenty of storage space, a guest toilet and direct access to a terrace and a beautiful private garden – ideal for enjoying the Mediterranean climate.
On the first floor is the sleeping area with three bedrooms, each with built-in wardrobes. The master bedroom is a true retreat with a walk-in wardrobe and a luxurious en-suite bathroom. The other rooms share a stylishly finished bathroom.
In the basement, you will discover a versatile extra space that you can furnish as you wish: playroom, home office, study or hobby room – the possibilities are endless.
Communal areas as an extension of your home The complex has a communal swimming pool and landscaped gardens: the perfect place to cool off in the summer, relax or socialise with neighbours.
More than just a home Lavanda Villas is not just a place to live, but a home to grow into, share and create unforgettable moments with your family.
Seize the opportunity now Don't miss this exclusive opportunity and discover what it's like to live in one of the most sought-after neighbourhoods in Vélez-Málaga.

Charming Estate with Rental Income Potential in Serene Natural Setting
Just 35 km from Málaga Airport and 5 km from Casarabonela, this exceptional irrigated estate offers peace, beauty, and endless possibilities.
Nestled among centuries-old olive trees and enriched by a stream that keeps the land lush year-round, the property combines privacy with excellent accessibility.
At the top of a gentle hill stands the beautifully restored main house (91 m²), designed with light, comfort, and style.
It features an open-plan living room with kitchen, two double bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, and direct access to a shaded porch with panoramic views.
The estate also includes three independent casitas (34, 26, and 22m²). One is move-in ready, while two await installation of bathroom and kitchen, offering flexible use as guest houses, studios, or rentals.
A swimming pool completes the picture, perfectly placed to enjoy the tranquility of the stream.
With solar panels (off-grid electricity, connection to mains possible), town water, spacious parking, and a variety of fruit trees, this self-sufficient property is ideal as a private residence, holiday retreat, or tourism project.
A rare opportunity where nature, comfort, and inspiration meet.

Designed with flexibility and comfort in mind, the property currently offers two fully self-contained accommodations—each with private entrances, terraces, and modern conveniences.

title.en: Villa for sale in Alora

desc.en:
Nestled in the heart of the picturesque white village of Canillas de Aceituno, in the serene Axarquía region of Málaga province, this beautifully maintained 84 m² Townhouse offers the perfect blend of traditional Andalusian charm and comfort. Located just a 2-minute stroll from the vibrant village center, you'll have easy access to all essential amenities, including local shops, cozy cafés, restaurants, and community services, all set against the backdrop of a dynamic and authentic Spanish community. Canillas de Aceituno, with its winding cobblestone streets and its stunning views of the Sierra Tejeda Natural Park, is a hidden gem that promises a peaceful yet enriching lifestyle.
Property Features: Welcoming Front Terrace: Step onto the inviting front terrace, a perfect spot to enjoy morning coffee or evening sunsets while soaking in the tranquil village atmosphere.
Entrance Hall: The entrance hall sets a warm tone, leading you into the heart of this charming home.
Three Spacious Bedrooms: The townhouse boasts three generously sized bedrooms, each filled with natural light, offering ample space for family, guests, or a home office. A well-appointed bathroom serves the household, designed with functionality and comfort in mind.
Cozy Interior Patio: The delightful patio provides a private outdoor retreat, ideal for relaxing.
Bright Living Room: The airy living room is a welcoming space for gatherings, with large windows that flood the area with natural light and offer glimpses of the village's charm.
Kitchen-Diner: The spacious kitchen is perfect for culinary enthusiasts, featuring plenty of counter space and room for a dining table, making it a hub for meals and socializing.
Handy Storage Room: A practical storage room ensures all your belongings have a place, keeping the home clutter-free and organized.
Why Canillas de Aceituno? This authentic white village, perched in the foothills of the Sierra Tejeda, is renowned for its breathtaking scenery, rich cultural heritage, and vibrant community spirit. Canillas de Aceituno offers a peaceful escape while remaining well-connected, with Málaga’s vibrant city center and its international airport just a scenic 45-minute drive away and the beach in less then 30 min. The village is a haven for outdoor enthusiasts, with hiking trails, cycling routes, and proximity to Lake Viñuela, perfect for water activities or leisurely picnics. Local festivals, traditional cuisine, and a warm, welcoming community make this an ideal location for those seeking an authentic Andalusian lifestyle.
Perfect For: This townhouse is a dream opportunity for buyers looking for a low budget permanent residence, a holiday home, or a lucrative investment property in one of Málaga’s most enchanting villages. Whether you're drawn to the relaxed pace of village life, the stunning natural surroundings, or the chance to immerse yourself in Spanish culture, this home offers it all.
Don’t miss the chance to own a piece of paradise in Canillas de Aceituno. Contact us today to arrange a viewing and start your Andalusian adventure!

Welcome to Casa La Colina – Your dream home on the Costa Tropical Located in a charming and well-maintained urbanisation between Salobreña and Almuñécar, in the sun-drenched south of Granada, Casa La Colina welcomes you to an oasis of tranquillity, comfort and views.
Layout and living areas Upon arrival, you enter an attractive front garden with a terrace, where picturesque steps lead you to the front door of the house. Once inside, you find yourself in a bright and spacious living area, equipped with air conditioning and direct access to one of the beautiful terraces with breathtaking sea views – a perfect place to enjoy the sunrise or a relaxing evening.
The living room has a cosy bar connected to the fully equipped kitchen – everything you need is here. This floor also has a bathroom and two spacious bedrooms.
An internal staircase leads to a second living area on the lower floor, where there are two more bathrooms and a small hall. There is also plenty of storage space here, and this floor gives access to a separate entrance hall, making the property ideal for dividing into two independent apartments or using as a B&B – with excellent rental potential.
A second staircase leads to the lower level of the house, where there are three additional bedrooms and a separate toilet.
Outdoor space and amenities The entire plot is fenced and offers several terraces with beautiful views and plenty of privacy. The garden is planted with beautiful vegetation and offers enough space for a prefabricated swimming pool. An outdoor shower is already provided, and the garden can be further landscaped to your own taste.
On the lowest level of the plot is a separate garage with direct access to the connecting road, ideal as a workspace or storage area. This space also has an entrance to the garden and the house. In addition, there is a second garage with a gate at the front of the house.
Additional advantages Casa La Colina is part of an urbanisation with year-round access to a beautiful communal swimming pool, located within walking distance and slightly higher up in the neighbourhood. There is also access to a tennis court for sports enthusiasts.
Summary This property is a unique opportunity: ✔ Versatile layout – ideal as a large family home, holiday home or investment ✔ Possibility of dividing into two separate residential units ✔ Multiple terraces, sea view, garage(s) and garden ✔ Communal swimming pool and tennis court ✔ Located within walking distance of the beach and close to the centre of Salobreña

Authentic finca near Riogordo (Málaga, Costa del Sol) – ready to move in with swimming pool, solar panels and beautiful views
This excellently maintained finca is located just 10 minutes from the charming white village of Riogordo, with all amenities, and a 40-minute drive from the beaches of the Costa del Sol. Malaga airport can be reached within 45 minutes from the property. The house is easily accessible via a well-maintained path and offers peace, privacy and breathtaking views over the rolling countryside and valley.
Main building A characterful entrance gate leads to the grounds, where there is ample parking space for several cars. The main building has three bedrooms and two bathrooms, spread over two floors.
Ground floor:
- Two bedrooms, one with en-suite washbasin and toilet. - Bathroom with shower. - Bedrooms equipped with ceiling fans. - Living room with wooden windows (double glazing), cosy wood-burning stove and open oven. - Kitchen with gas stove/oven, microwave, refrigerator and freezer.
First floor:
- One bedroom with mobile air conditioning. - Bathroom with shower. - Spacious mezzanine of approx. 40 m², ideal as an extra sitting or working space.
Sustainable facilities The house is equipped with 8 solar panels (450W each) with a 3 kW inverter, its own water source with a 17,000 litre storage tank. Hot water is generated by an electric boiler.
Additional building & outdoor living The second building offers plenty of possibilities: - Outdoor kitchen with barbecue, sink, pizza/bread oven and refrigerator. - Covered lounge/space measuring 7.5 x 4 m (30 m²), ideal for parties or easily converted into a guest suite. - Storage room with materials. - Water storage tank with a capacity of 17,000 litres. - Toilet and changing room by the pool.
Outdoor space The spacious sun terrace around the pool (3 x 6 m, chlorine) invites you to relax and enjoy the beautiful view. The olive trees on the property provide you with your own olive oil every year.
This finca combines authentic Andalusian charm with modern conveniences, sustainable energy supply and a beautiful location. Ready to move in and perfect for both permanent living and holiday accommodation. We would be happy to make an appointment with you to discover and experience this property... we don't just sell a property... we make your dreams come true...

The property is easily accessible, with a 200-meter driveway and a stream running along the property, enhancing the natural charm. The municipality is also planning to repair the road for improved access.
This property offers ample parking space and is located in a tranquil area with easy access to nearby amenities. It's an ideal home for those looking for a peaceful retreat with beautiful views and plenty of space.

title.en: Villa for sale in Mijas

desc.en:
A unique opportunity to buy a large home at a very good price!
The spacious and cosy villa of 224M2, in a peaceful urbanization in Alcaucin, is conventiely located at just 2 minutes walk of the shops and restaurants in Puente don Manuel, only 20 min from the coast and 40 min from Malaga. It is surrounded by beautiful views of the nature and has an easy access to Lake Viñuela and the nearby natural park.
The property has a gated entrance and there is ample parking at the street. A cosy hallway provides access to the living room on the left and the 2 spacious ground floor bedrooms and the 2 bathrooms on the right. The bedrooms all have fitted wardrobes. A stair leads to the lower level which consists of a huge separate guest wing, with its own private entrance. It has 2 large bedrooms, a bathroom, a laundry area, a dining room, a kitchen, storage space and a living room with direct access to the pool area and the garden. The house can accommodate 11 people!! Which also makes it perfect to have rental income if you wish.
The pool area with sunbeds on the large terrace area surrounded by the mature gardenis really a wonderfull place where you will especially enjoy the lovely mountain views. And for sure you will be tempted to drink a glass of Cava in the 7mx4 m pool or in the jacuzzi while watching the sunset.. At the back of the pool area you have the room with the pool pump system as well as a storage place.
Back on the first floor you enter the spacious and bright living room with a woodburner for the cooler winters. The covered terrace might be the place where you will spend most of your time while enjoying the views and as it is directly connected to the living room and the kitchen. The kitchen has its own handy storage space. The property is connected to the mains electricity and water network and it even has a 1.000 liter water reserve.
This property offers a unique opportunity to acquire a spacious and very functional urban home in the heart of Puente Don Manuel. With its central location, near to the bar’s, restaurants and the supermarket and the potential to customise the property to your own taste and use, this is an excellent choice!

title.en: Villa for sale in Alcaucín

desc.en:
Superb Business Opportunity – Bar & Restaurant with Owner’s Accommodation and Guest Apartment Between Cómpeta & Torrox
An exceptional opportunity to acquire a successful bar and restaurant business with spacious on-site owner’s accommodation and a separate guest apartment, all set on a generous plot in a prime location between the charming villages of Cómpeta and Torrox.
Interior Layout:
The ground floor is dedicated to the business premises and includes a large, partially shaded front terrace with ample space for client seating—ideal for outdoor dining in a relaxed setting. Inside, the bar area features a welcoming dining space, pool table, and a cosy open fireplace. A separate private dining room is perfect for group bookings or special events.
Supporting the business is a fully equipped commercial kitchen with an adjoining utility area, as well as ladies’ and gents’ restrooms and two large storage rooms, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations.
Steps lead up to the owner’s private accommodation, offering a comfortable and spacious living area. The main living-dining room includes a wood-burning stove and opens out onto a balcony terrace with sweeping countryside views. This level also features an open-plan kitchen, two double bedrooms (one with en suite), a single bedroom, and a full family bathroom—ideal for a family or live-in manager.
In addition, a separate guest apartment—currently undergoing refurbishment—comprises two double bedrooms, one bathroom, and an open-plan living space with a fitted kitchen and breakfast bar. It also has direct access to a large roof terrace, offering spectacular 360º views of the coastline and surrounding hills.
Exterior and Plot:
Set on a level plot, the property benefits from low-maintenance gardens, multiple terraces, and ample parking space for both guests and staff. The land is partially fenced, offering privacy and practical boundaries for the business and residential areas.
Location:
Perfectly positioned between Cómpeta (10-minute drive) and Torrox (20-minute drive), the property offers easy access to both mountain village charm and coastal amenities. Málaga Airport is just one hour away, making this a highly accessible destination for visitors and tourists.
Summary:
This is a superb opportunity to invest in a well-established hospitality business with multiple income streams. Live comfortably on-site, operate a popular bar and restaurant, and benefit from rental income via the guest apartment. Whether you're looking to relocate, invest, or expand into rural tourism, this property offers both lifestyle and business potential in the heart of Andalusia.

title.en: Penthouse for sale in Estepona

desc.en:
Welcome to your sun-kissed paradise on Estepona’s coveted New Golden Mile, a region renowned for its consistently sunny skies, golden sands, and the crystal-clear waters of southern Spain. Here, you’ll experience the best of this Mediterranean lifestyle with just 25 stunning apartments, designed for those who appreciate an exclusive and private community of like-minded neighbours.
An Intimate and Exclusive Community This residence offers far more than sea views and easy access to the finest beaches of southern Spain. This boutique residential community guarantees you privacy and a peaceful atmosphere, while also allowing you to connect with a select group of neighbours. The thoughtfully designed environment ensures that your living experience feels more like residing in a small, tranquil town rather than an apartment complex. Walking paths replace traditional hallways, connecting the apartments with the feel of single-family homes. This design maximizes outdoor spaces, turning terraces into extensions of the living area.
Designed by Leading Architects Crafted by the renowned Schiemann Weyers Architects (Rotterdam) and OCWA Architects (Marbella), the development promises both sophistication and top-tier quality. All apartments are strategically positioned to face south, allowing for maximum exposure to Estepona’s mild winters and year-round natural light. The architectural design emphasizes indoor-outdoor living, with sliding doors that harmonize the transition from the living rooms to the spacious terraces.
Interiors that Blend Elegance and Functionality The interiors of the apartments have been meticulously designed to blend elegance with functionality. Available in Standard and Premium options, each apartment comes fully furnished with underfloor heating, Schneider light switches, smart locks, and basic climate automation. These smart features extend to water-saving systems in the bathrooms and kitchens, emphasizing sustainability without compromising on luxury.
For the kitchen, residents can enjoy fully fitted and equipped spaces with Swedish ASKO appliances, including stovetops, ovens, hoods, dishwashers, and refrigerators. The laundry areas are equipped with washing and drying machines from the same high-quality brand. The bathrooms are outfitted with German-made Villeroy & Boch fixtures, ensuring a high standard of comfort and design.
Emphasis on Outdoor Living In this development, the terrace is more than just an outdoor space—it’s an extension of your living room. The generous, greenery-lined terraces are designed for privacy, with wooden Mallorcan blinds providing shade while also allowing air to circulate. Some units feature movable walls that adapt to the evolving needs of families, creating flexible and functional spaces.
Amenities for a Luxurious Lifestyle Residents here enjoy an array of amenities that cater to a luxurious Mediterranean lifestyle. The complex includes a large pool where you can cool off, relax on a sun lounger with a poolside cocktail, or watch the kids splash around in their own designated children’s pool.
For those who prioritize health and wellness, the on-site gym offers a convenient place to stay active, while the Hammam area provides a serene space for relaxation. Other practical features include underground parking with 31 spaces, a storage room, and pre-installation for an electric vehicle charging station. The complex is equipped with an automatic doorman, a security system, and keycard access, ensuring both convenience and peace of mind.
Sustainability and Eco-Conscious Design This development places a strong emphasis on sustainability. The ecological energy and water systems are designed to reduce your carbon footprint while maintaining the highest standards of comfort and luxury. The functional vegetation throughout the property serves not only a decorative purpose but also helps reduce the sun’s heat, making outdoor spaces more enjoyable even during the hottest months.
Flexible Apartment Options The residence offers a range of apartment types, each designed with unique features to suit different lifestyles. With sizes ranging from 104 to 244 square meters, including terraces and rooftop solariums, there’s an option for everyone. The single-level and two-level units all feature private terraces, and some even have rooftop solariums for enjoying Estepona’s famous sunshine in privacy.
Optional features for select apartments include a hot tub on the terrace, charging points for electric cars, and photovoltaic panels, particularly beneficial for Type 2 and Type 3 apartments. These optional upgrades allow residents to further personalize their living spaces.
The Mediterranean Lifestyle at Your Doorstep This development is perfectly situated to take full advantage of all that the Costa del Sol has to offer. Just a 7-minute walk from the beach, you’ll wake up to views of the Mediterranean Sea on one side and the majestic Sierra Bermeja mountains on the other. Estepona itself is known for its high-end yet low-rise architecture, ensuring your sea views and the long-term value of your investment are both protected.
Whether you’re an avid golfer, equestrian enthusiast, or simply love the beach, the location offers unparalleled access to the best of the region. The nearby coastline boasts famous beaches, vibrant marinas, and world-class golf courses and equestrian clubs.
Conveniently Connected The development is also ideally located for travel. With two international airports—Malaga and Gibraltar—just 40 minutes away, you’re never far from other major destinations. One-hour flights will take you to Madrid, Barcelona, Lisbon, and Casablanca, making both business and leisure travel a breeze.

Mijas - Málaga: The Joy of Living
This new project is located in the municipality of Mijas, in the heart of the Western Costa del Sol—a town that perfectly blends beach tourism with a welcoming residential atmosphere. With its privileged location between the sea and the mountains, Mijas offers endless charm. Winters are mild, and summers enjoy a warm, yet moderate, climate.
The coastline of Mijas is rich in biodiversity, where a variety of Atlantic and Mediterranean species coexist. This area has a unique appeal, offering a blend of tradition and adaptation to modern times, while staying true to its authentic roots. Living by the coast, you can savor an array of fresh seafood, caught daily, paired with the renowned sweet wines of the Málaga region and delicious Arab-inspired pastries. You’ll also find a range of prestigious restaurants serving locally sourced dishes of exceptional quality.
A Place Steeped in Culture
La Cala de Mijas preserves a significant historical heritage, reflected in its four towers: Torre de Calahonda, Torre Batería de la Cala del Moral, Torre de Calaburras (dating back to the 16th century), and Torre Nueva de la Cala del Moral from the 19th century. In Mijas Pueblo’s historic center, there are plenty of places to visit, including the remains of the Arab Wall, the Hermitage of the Virgen de la Peña, and other historical landmarks such as the Flour Mill, the Historical-Ethnological Museum, and the Contemporary Art Center.
Project
This new project is a modern, gated residential complex designed for comfortable living. Construction has already begun, and sales officially start in March 2025, with delivery expected by the end of 2026—now is the time to reserve your unit! The development includes 72 apartments with 2, 3, and 4 bedrooms, available on the ground floor, first, second, and penthouse levels. Most homes are south or southwest-facing, offering stunning sea views from many units. Ground-floor apartments feature lovely private gardens, while penthouses come with spacious terraces. Each home includes at least one parking space and a storage unit. Every detail has been thoughtfully crafted to make this your future home, offering stylish and functional urban living with top-tier finishes.
In addition to these luxurious amenities, public transportation is conveniently located just around the corner, and the area is surrounded by numerous shops, bars, and restaurants to make day-to-day living easy and enjoyable.
Community Spaces
The communal areas are designed for relaxation and fitness in a peaceful setting. New Project offers beautifully landscaped gardens with a community pool, a gym, and a social-gourmet lounge, so you can make the most of your free time.
Pool
The pool is designed to make summer days cooler and more enjoyable.
Gym
Staying fit and leading a healthy lifestyle has never been easier. Enjoy your workout without leaving the community.
Social-Gourmet Lounge
The social-gourmet lounge is a fully equipped, elegantly modern space where you can host memorable gatherings with friends and family.

Main villa The main villa is spread over two floors and features a spacious entrance hall, an open-plan kitchen with dining room, a cozy living room with a fireplace, a small storage room, and a games room on the ground floor. On the first floor, there are three bedrooms, one of which has an en-suite bathroom and a walk-in closet. Another bedroom has a built-in closet. There are also two terraces: one facing east and one facing west, allowing you to enjoy the sun all day long.
Ground floor apartment The second property, a ground floor apartment with a tourist rental license, has two bedrooms, one of which has an en-suite bathroom. The apartment also has a cozy living room, a fully equipped kitchen, and another full bathroom. The property has direct access to the pool and a private terrace with an outdoor dining area and barbecue.
Outdoor space The plot covers an area of 1,627 m² and is beautifully landscaped. It creates a Mediterranean and rural atmosphere. The swimming pool is located on a spacious terrace and there is an outdoor kitchen. There are parking spaces on both sides of the house, one of which is covered. Behind the house is a laundry room and a small separate shed.
Facilities The property has running water, its own well, and a water reservoir. The electricity is connected to the grid, and the ground floor of both the main villa and the apartment have air conditioning. The first floor of the main villa has central heating, ensuring optimal comfort during every season.
Location The location of this country house is truly ideal. The transport links are excellent, putting you just 15 minutes from the beaches of the Costa Tropical. What's more, you are only a few minutes from the motorway, which means you can quickly reach the beautiful Lecrín Valley. For lovers of nature and water, the beautiful river in Vélez de Benaudalla is also nearby.
An additional advantage of this location is its proximity to the Sierra Nevada, where you can be on the slopes within an hour and a half and enjoy a day in the snow. This property combines the best of both worlds: the sun and sea of the coast and the winter fun of the mountains.
This special country house offers both privacy and the possibility of tourist rentals, ideal for people who want to enjoy nature and the proximity to the coast. Don't miss this opportunity to live in a beautiful environment with a unique character!

Modern Villa with Spectacular Views on Mount Bentomiz – Arenas
This recently renovated modern villa enjoys a stunning location on the Bentomiz mountain in Arenas — just 5 minutes from the picturesque white village, 20 minutes from Algarrobo Costa, and 50 minutes from Málaga Airport.
The home is filled with natural light and features a spacious open-plan living area with a lounge, dining space, and a high-quality modern kitchen equipped with a gas hob, oven, dishwasher, and built-in fridge-freezer. From the dining area, large sliding doors open onto a covered terrace, perfect for enjoying outdoor dining and panoramic views.
The villa offers three bedrooms and three bathrooms (two en suite): - On the ground floor, you’ll find a comfortable bedroom with en suite bathroom (shower, toilet, sink) and air conditioning. - A second bedroom with separate bathroom (bath/shower, toilet, sink). - The master suite is located on the upper floor and features air conditioning, a private en suite bathroom, and a dressing room. From here, you have direct access to the roof terrace — the ideal place to relax and enjoy breathtaking views and unforgettable sunsets.
All bedrooms and the living room are equipped with ceiling fans for additional comfort during the summer months.
Outside, the property boasts a saltwater pool (9.5m x 5m) with automatic maintenance system, surrounded by various shaded terraces — one of which can be closed with a toldo for year-round use. The automated irrigation system keeps the garden lush and green with ease.
The villa is energy-efficient and secure, featuring:
- 8 solar panels with a 6 kW inverter - Central heating and hot water via gas boiler - Double, burglar-proof glazing - Comprehensive security system (interior and exterior surveillance) - Home automation system to control lighting, heating, solar panels, and water tank data
Water is supplied via a shared well and stored in a 12,000L tank.
This is a truly exceptional home that combines modern comfort, energy efficiency, and spectacular Andalusian scenery.

Welcome to Riogordo, one of the charming municipalities in the beautiful region of Andalusia, located in the picturesque mountains of the Montes de Málaga, just 40 kilometers north of the bustling city of Málaga. In the heart of Riogordo we offer a beautiful villa, conveniently located close to all amenities within walking distance, including supermarkets, restaurants, bars, a pharmacy, a doctor's office and schools.
The villa extends over two floors, with the top floor currently used as a living area and the lower floor as a commercial space, with a flower shop and hair salon.
Upon entering from the street side and through a small patio, you enter the house on the first floor, where a corridor leads to two spacious bedrooms on either side. On the right is a spacious living room with lots of natural light and an impressive fireplace. On the left you will find the third bedroom, adjacent to a spacious bathroom with a large sink, toilet, bidet and a walk-in shower. The spacious kitchen with cooking island is adjacent to a covered terrace with a breathtaking view of Riogordo and the rolling hills. From here stairs lead to the lower floor with a large barbecue area, garden and large entrance gate to the street with ample parking.
On the lower floor there is a second bathroom with toilet, sink and walk-in shower, together with two additional bedrooms and a reception room where a further bedroom could be created. You will also find a flower shop with a large cold room and a hairdresser's shop here. These shops can be taken over or converted into multiple (bed)rooms or bathrooms.
This unique home offers an unprecedented amount of possibilities, whether it concerns taking over or starting a business, or transforming it into a charming Bed & Breakfast. Make your entrepreneurial dreams come true in this beautiful villa in the heart of Riogordo.
